title: Eight tools, shown in action
intro: Choose a numbered tool to compare real App states before and after an action. Enlarge any screenshot to inspect the details.

select.name: Select
select.action: Click the rectangle to select it, then drag its edge to move the whole shape.
select.result: The rectangle moves together with its selection box, and the position values update in the inspector.

point-edit.name: Point editing
point-edit.action: Select the Bezier path, switch to Edit, then drag an anchor point to reshape the curve.
point-edit.result: The anchor moves and the curve changes with it. Its control handles remain available for further adjustments.

pencil.name: Pencil
pencil.action: Choose Pencil, press and drag across the canvas, then release to finish the stroke.
pencil.result: The stroke becomes an editable vector path. Click the selected Pencil tool again to open its smoothness options.

line.name: Line
line.action: Press at the start point, drag to the end point, then release.
line.result: A straight line connects the two points.

rectangle.name: Rectangle
rectangle.action: Press at one corner and drag to the opposite corner, then release.
rectangle.result: The two corners define the completed rectangle.

circle.name: Circle
circle.action: Press at the centre and drag outwards to set the radius, then release.
circle.result: A circle appears around the starting point, which is its centre.

polygon.name: Polygon
polygon.action: Click each vertex in turn. After at least three points, click the starting point to close the shape.
polygon.result: The last vertex connects to the first, forming a closed polygon.

bezier.name: Bezier
bezier.action: Click to place the start point, drag out handles at the next anchor, then add the end point. Press Enter to finish the open curve.
bezier.result: The completed curve remains an editable path. Switch to Edit to refine its anchors and handles.
